exact_catalytic_condition: controller begins in a known basis state and is returned uncorrelated in that state
reset_cost: beta W >= h2(p) only when an uncertain retained classical record diag(1-p,p) must be erased
theorem: The time-independent finite Hamiltonian H=pi |1><1| tensor (I-SWAP)/2 generates controlled-SWAP exactly at dimensionless time one and conserves the controller basis state. A known program bit is therefore an exact catalyst with no universal positive erasure cost. An uncertain retained program record has entropy h2(p), and reset in a supplied thermal bath obeys beta W>=h2(p). Catalytic use and cyclic reset are distinct resource statements.
